text:
leah_docs: Quick question — we're adding an example for region fallback when a customer requests a model in an unsupported region. Should the SDK snippet show automatic fallback to nearest region or explicit error + retry?

sam_devex: I'd prefer explicit fallback with a clear opt-in flag. silent fallback can surprise teams. :thinking_face:

mikael_infra: +1 to explicit. Also call out data residency ramifications — if they opt-in to fallback, data may cross regions. Legal/Compliance needs to sign off.

ana_i18n: Also need translations for the error message when fallback is disabled. The English text currently: "Region not available for requested model. Set region_fallback=true to attempt nearest endpoint." We should provide FR/DE/JA placeholders.

leah_docs: Good call. I'll draft snippet with an opt-in flag and include a small table explaining residency behavior. Will ping legal.

jordan_product: Keep the snippet minimal — users love 3 lines of code. Put the residency note beneath with a link to the residency page.

leah_docs: Drafting now — putting sample for Python + JS. 

leah_docs:
```python
# explicit region fallback
client = Redwood(api_key=REDWOOD_KEY, region='eu-west-1', region_fallback=False)
try:
    resp = client.generate(model='redwood-large')
except RegionUnavailableError:
    # instruct user how to opt-in
    raise RuntimeError('Region not available. Set region_fallback=True to try nearest endpoint')
```

leah_docs:
```js
// opt-in fallback example
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, region: 'ap-northeast-1', regionFallback: true })
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-large' })
```

sam_devex: Nice. Can we add a one-liner warning badge above the Python example: "⚠️ Data may leave the requested region if you enable fallback" ?

leah_docs: Done in the draft. 

docs-bot: leah_docs opened PR #4823: docs: add region-fallback SDK examples + residency note — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823

mikael_infra: I left inline comments on the PR about wording for "nearest endpoint" — we should define what "nearest" means (latency vs legal boundary). 

ana_i18n: For translations, I'll add i18n keys: docs.region_fallback.warning, docs.region_fallback.error. I'll propose French + Japanese strings in the PR.

jordan_product: Legal review required for the residency paragraph. @carla_legal can you take a look?

carla_legal: looking now. Quick note: if fallback might route to a different legal jurisdiction, we can't advise customers to enable it for regulated data. We should add a stronger restriction.

leah_docs: Got it. I'll update the residency line to: "Not recommended for regulated data — contact support for dedicated capacity." 

sam_devex: After legal text updated, can someone run a small smoke test on the JS snippet? @mikael_infra?

mikael_infra: I ran it locally against staging, fallback flag toggles as expected. Logged a tiny SDK issue #709 about the error class name mismatch; linking in the PR.

leah_docs: Updated PR with legal wording and i18n placeholders. Ready for one more review.

jordan_product: Reviewed, looks good. Merge when legal approves and SDK issue linked.

carla_legal: Approved with edits. Marking TODO to notify sales about the new guidance.

leah_docs: Thanks all :tada: I'll merge after CI and add a docs release note.
